newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Metal workers on strike, demand wages.
newsitem.headline: Metal workers on strike, demand wages.

text.p: Some 1,800 workers of Montenegro's biggest metals factory Radoje Dakic went on strike demanding unpaid wages and punishment for its former management.
"We ask criminal proceedings for previous managers. We demand three months unpaid salaries," Dakic workers told Reuters on Wednesday.
Radoje Dakic was one of the biggest plants in tiny Montenegro which together with Serbia comprises Yugoslavia.
It used to produce annually more than 800 heavy construction machines in 1990. Sanctions against Yugoslavia suspended its 20-year cooperation with German partner Liebher.
Over 1,000 workers are on compulsory leave and 800 workers service old products or assemble quartz-heaters.
